title: Transient spike + continuous baseline harness for Dedicated autoscaler validation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Build and run a long-duration Dedicated capacity harness that combines a steady-state baseline with frequent transient spikes to validate autoscaler hysteresis, model-variant fallbacks, and KV cache warmup effects. This ticket covers harness definition, metric instrumentation (tokens/sec, p95 latency, error rates), regression detection logic against historical baselines, and automated run reports for SRE/Platform review. Rationale: existing soak runs cover sustained bursts and evening peaks, but we lack a repeatable waveform that mixes microbursts with continuous traffic to surface oscillation, slow leak regressions, and cold-cache latency regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run a 72-hour job that emits a configurable baseline qps and scheduled microbursts with target token/sec waveform
Autoscaler metrics collected: queue_depth_by_model, replicas, scale_events, token_rate, cpu_gpu_util, kv_cache_hit_rate
Run report shows p95 latency, p99 latency, tokens/sec, error_rate, and a regression score compared to the last 4 baseline runs
Regression detection flags via Mann-Whitney U or bootstrap that trigger a CI annotation when p95 increases > 15% with p < 0.05
Playbook entry created for persistent oscillation cases and linked from run output
No customer-facing incidents caused by harness runs in Dedicated - all runs confined to test capacity pools
steps: Design waveform: baseline 1200 tokens/sec steady-state; microbursts every 15 minutes of 10s at 12k tokens/sec; one large burst per 6 hours to simulate customer peak
Extend soakrunner to support: model-targeted workload, KV cache prewarming toggles, and emit queue_depth metric via autoscaler exporter
Add statistical regression module that compares recent run distribution to canonical baseline and computes CI and effect size
Provision dedicated test pool with isolate=true and tag harness-run; ensure no production capacity overlap
Run initial 24h smoke, capture metrics to grafana and perfdb, iterate on thresholds
Run full 72h soak and publish run report + annotated timeline for SRE/PM/Design review
